zh.caseTitle: 案件：全班成绩为什么下滑
zh.testimony: 解释一：这学期开始，班主任要求全班每天用平板交作业，之后月考成绩明显下滑，所以是平板作业拖垮了成绩。解释二：我儿子同桌最近迷上了打游戏，天天考倒数，可见这一代孩子沉迷游戏才是成绩下滑的根本原因。解释三：这学期换了数学老师、教材也改版了，还赶上流感停课两周——成绩下滑更可能来自这些变化。

textRefs.spot_blame: 这学期开始，班主任要求全班每天用平板交作业，之后月考成绩明显下滑，所以是平板作业拖垮了成绩
textRefs.spot_exam: 我儿子同桌最近迷上了打游戏，天天考倒数，可见这一代孩子沉迷游戏才是成绩下滑的根本原因
textRefs.debunk_blame: 时间先后≠因果：用平板交作业和成绩下滑同时发生，可能是巧合，也可能有共同原因（如换老师）——不能直接归咎平板。
textRefs.debunk_exam: 以偏概全：一个同桌的例子推不出「这一代孩子」的整体结论——单一样本撑不起大结论。
textRefs.q_blame: 成绩下滑一定是因为平板作业吗？有没有同时发生的其他变化？
textRefs.q_exam: 一个同桌的情况，能代表这一代孩子吗？

hints: 「之后」不等于「因为」——找同时发生的其他变化
一个孩子的例子，代表不了「这一代孩子」
解释三提出了真正的替代原因——它不是破绽
zh.explanation: 成绩下滑的归因里，解释一犯了「时间先后≠因果」（忽略换老师等共同变化），解释二犯了「以偏概全」（同桌≠这一代），解释三给出了合理的替代原因组合。给任何现象找原因时，先问：还有没有别的解释？

en.caseTitle: Case: Why Did the Whole Class's Grades Drop?
en.witnessName: Three explanations in the parents' group
en.testimony: Explanation one: this semester the homeroom teacher required the whole class to hand in homework via tablet, and grades clearly dropped afterward, so tablet homework dragged down the grades. Explanation two: my son's deskmate recently got addicted to games and keeps scoring at the bottom — clearly this generation's gaming addiction is the root cause of falling grades. Explanation three: this semester the math teacher changed, the textbook was revised, and a flu outbreak canceled two weeks of class — the drop is more likely due to these changes.

textRefs.spot_blame: this semester the homeroom teacher required the whole class to hand in homework via tablet, and grades clearly dropped afterward, so tablet homework dragged down the grades
textRefs.spot_exam: clearly this generation's gaming addiction is the root cause
textRefs.debunk_blame: After this, therefore because of this: tablet homework and the grade drop coincided — it could be coincidence, or share a common cause (like the teacher change); tablets cannot be blamed directly.
textRefs.debunk_exam: Hasty generalization: one deskmate's case cannot support a conclusion about "this generation" — a single sample cannot carry a sweeping claim.
textRefs.q_blame: Must the grade drop come from tablet homework? Were there other simultaneous changes?
textRefs.q_exam: Can one deskmate's situation represent this generation?
textRefs.q_d1: What brand of tablet was used?
textRefs.q_d2: How many subjects did the monthly exam cover?
textRefs.q_d3: What time does the homeroom teacher leave work?

hints: "Afterward" is not "because of" — look for other simultaneous changes
One child's example cannot represent "this generation"
Explanation three offers the real rival causes — it is not a flaw
en.explanation: In attributing the grade drop, explanation one commits post hoc (ignoring simultaneous changes like the new teacher), explanation two commits hasty generalization (deskmate ≠ generation), and explanation three offers a reasonable set of rival causes. When hunting for a cause, first ask: what other explanations exist?
